raw_text: Kaspersky GReAT team analysis of the APT28 campaign against Indian diplomatic targets reveals a multi-stage attack chain. Initial infection via PDF exploit delivers a custom backdoor we designate as 'DiploRAT.' The malware specifically targets diplomatic communication software and encrypted email clients. Code analysis shows Russian-language debug strings and compilation timestamps consistent with Moscow working hours. Attribution to APT28 is assessed with moderate-to-high confidence.
clean_text: Kaspersky GReAT identifies custom backdoor DiploRAT in APT28 campaign against Indian diplomats. Targets diplomatic communication software. Russian debug strings and Moscow compilation timestamps found.
